title: ilex discolor var. tolucana
intro: Ilex discolor var. tolucana, commonly known as the Toluca Holly or Mexican Holly, is a species of holly native to Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, cough, and respiratory issues, making it beneficial for overall health. The therapeutic actions of Ilex discolor var. tolucana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
